# Phase Three — Tiferes: Final Execution Graph

The Awtsmoos joins diagnosis and repair in one line; Awtsmoos.com lets each verified change become a clean vessel in time.

## Wave 1 — Diagnose and repair encoder flow
- Read every function implementing `AwtsVideoBase.addCanvasFrame`, queue processing, video source creation, and finalization.
- Read worker message handler and failure routing.
- Reproduce with a lightweight >12-frame probe if needed.
- Create focused queue/backpressure helper modules under `scripts/awtsmoos/video/base/` only if the shared wrapper must change.
- Rewrite the owning shared base file fully with tabs/JSDoc/Awtsmoos poetry if touched.
- Split `AnimatorBrowserWorkerSession.js` into session + frame pump/request broker if its control flow needs instrumentation.

## Wave 2 — Source freeze and tests
- Add encoder progress/backpressure regression test.
- Run all canonical movie tests and relevant existing export tests.
- Run syntax/import checks and file hygiene.

## Wave 3 — Runtime proof
- Keep or restart local proof server and Blob receiver.
- Render short proof.
- Render full 180 seconds.
- Persist Blob.
- ffprobe.
- ffmpeg witness frames and diversity analysis.
- Browser console triage.

## Wave 4 — UX and architecture closure
- Mobile director narrow-viewport interaction proof.
- Refactor legacy over-120 export page.
- Search hidden importers/tests/docs.
- Update evidence ledger, remaining work, planned-vs-actual delta, and handoff docs.
- Re-read all touched files and rerun verification.

## Completion gate
Only stop when the full 180-second MP4 exists in the evidence folder, its streams/duration are measured, distant frames are visibly diverse, tests and browser flows are green, touched files satisfy the code constitution, and the refreshed remaining-work artifact contains no safe unresolved node.
